newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GRINAKER RESTRUCTURES, GETS BLACK PARTNER.
newsitem.headline: GRINAKER RESTRUCTURES, GETS BLACK PARTNER.

text.p: South African firms Q Data Ltd and black-owned Kunene Bros will buy equal 25.5 percent stakes in Grinaker Holdings Ltd and 2.625 percent interests in Grintek Ltd from Anglo Vaal Industries Ltd, the groups said on Friday.
They said in a published announcement that the acquisition would take place with the support of senior management in the Grinaker group, which comprises Q Data, Grinaker, Grintek and Siltek Ltd .

Q Data and Kunene will each hold less than 35 percent of the shares in Grinaker and the Securities Regulation Panel has indicated that the acquisition does not require an offer to be made to minority shareholders in the group.
Discussions were continuing to fulfil certain resolutive conditions ahead of the purchase and shareholders were therefore advised to continue to exercise caution in their share dealings.
The announcement follows a cautionary this week that the group was in talks which fuelled share prices of the various firms on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
Analysts had expected the group to streamline its electronics interests, suggesting a possible collapse of pyramid firm Grinaker and the housing of Grintek's electronic interests in Siltek.
